name: Kentaurosmon
main_effect:
When this card would be played, if there are 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, reduce the play cost by 6.
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place 1 yellow card from your hand as your top security card.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon suspends, by trashing your top security card, it unsuspends.
